title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (React/Golang)
description:
About the Product

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply. Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.

About the Role

We’re looking for a driven, resourceful, and experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join one of our growing product teams. As a senior member of the team, you will be tasked with designing, building, and enhancing services and user-facing features across our platform, with a strong focus on reliability, maintainability, scalability, and user experience. You’ll leverage your expertise spanning the entire stack, from database interactions to front-end libraries, contributing significantly to our technical direction and mentoring other engineers.

How you will make an impact

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable full-stack applications and features across a modern tech stack, including Typescript, React, Go and Postgres.
  • Focus on improving our user experience, collaborating with designers to implement intuitive interfaces and finding creative ways to reduce user pain points.
  • Build and enhance microservices, focusing on reliability, maintainability, and scalability within our distributed systems.
  • Ensure the quality of our products remains high by contributing to automated testing strategies and participating actively in code reviews.
  • Collaborate effectively with product managers, designers, QA analysts, and other engineers within an Agile development framework.
  • Contribute to engineering best practices, identifying and driving improvements in our processes, architecture, and technology stack.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a collaborative environment and sharing your expertise.
  • Distill user stories or business requirements into technical requirements and robust technical designs.

You may be a good fit for this role if you

  • Are passionate about coding and creating scalable systems and fantastic user experiences.
  • Embrace a growth mindset by continuously questioning established ideas and learning from your experiences.
  • Exhibit humility and a collaborative spirit, fostering a positive work environment while valuing the contributions of others without ego.
  • Value autonomy and empowerment to make your own decisions.

What you will do

During the 1st Month:

  • Attend onboarding sessions to better understand our internal processes and learn about the company
  • Pair with other engineers to learn more about our tech stack, the products we support, and our development standards and processes
  • Familiarize yourself with our automated testing platforms and begin to contribute to our test coverage
  • Collaborate with product team members to implement and ship small features and functionality

Within 3 Months:

  • Participate in code reviews and provide thoughtful, constructive feedback to other engineers
  • Gain exposure to the platform’s underlying infrastructure and deployment processes
  • Understand the high-level architecture of the website and back-end services
  • Begin shipping more complex user-facing code

Within 6 Months:

  • Grow as a contributing member of a product team, providing input and insight to the rest of the team on challenges and feasibility of proposed development
  • Confidently implement new functionality and fix bugs across our stack
  • Work with members of the tech and product teams to distill user stories or business requirements into technical requirements/design

Within 12 months:

  • Begin identifying areas for improvement in our codebase, researching best practices, and making recommendations to the team on strategies to address them
  • Solidify understanding of the breadth of our tech stack, including underlying infrastructure, internal tools, front end applications, and how they interact with our back-end services
  • Be a subject matter expert for the product team’s areas of responsibility

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Experience with Typescript and React
  • Experience with one or more general-purpose programming languages (Go, C/C++, C#, Java, Ruby, etc.)
  • Experience with one or more SQL databases
  • Strong understanding of common data structures and design patterns
  • Experience working with a microservice architecture and distributed systems
  • Proficiency in using unit testing frameworks
  • A dedication to developing clear, reliable, and maintainable code
  • Proficiency with common git operations
  • Strong communication skills, effectively conveying ideas to both technical and non-technical partners
  • Experience mentoring other engineers

title: PLM Windchill Developer
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced PLM Solution Specialist with strong expertise in PTC Windchill and ideally Dassault Systèmes 3DExperience (3DX) to support and optimize enterprise Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) initiatives. The role requires a blend of technical configuration, business process leadership, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver scalable PLM solutions aligned with business objectives.

Ideally, we would like to find professionals with knowledge and experience in both Windchill and 3DX . However, if one candidate is strong in Windchill and another is focused on 3DX, we will also consider this combination.

Key Responsibilities

PLM Systems Configuration & Support

  • Customize and configure Windchill and/or 3DX to meet company-specific requirements.
  • Build, update, and manage product data structures to support design and engineering teams.
  • Set up and improve change management processes (change requests, notices, approvals).
  • Configure and automate approval workflows for efficiency and compliance.
  • Modify and support lifecycle steps (draft, concept, design, released) to match internal business processes.
  • Integrate Windchill with SAP and other enterprise applications for design data management.
  • Suggest improvements for product data/document release processes, managing changes via JIRA.
  • Support system upgrades, testing, and technical improvements across global teams.

Business & Functional Leadership

  • Lead business and functional resources in the design of efficient enterprise business processes that leverage PLM solutions.
  • Facilitate workshops and working sessions to gather requirements, demonstrate software functions, or resolve issues.
  • Provide PLM application expertise to stakeholders for roadmap planning and technology evaluation.
  • Collaborate with the PLM Support team to ensure alignment on solution direction and strategy.
  • Provide high-level solution guidance and act as a change agent to drive adoption.
  • Perform cost-benefit analysis, define metrics, and track progress toward business objectives.
  • Develop standards, processes, procedures, and training materials to support PLM usage and adoption.
  • Analyze and revise existing systems and documentation to identify remediation or improvements.

Stakeholder & Relationship Management

  • Act as a trusted advisor with strong customer interfacing skills to communicate solution approaches.
  • Build and maintain relationships across business units, vendors, and technical teams.
  • Influence stakeholders, build support for PLM initiatives, and manage constructive tension when needed.
  • Lead design-related workshops, drive issue resolution, and ensure alignment across functions.

Qualifications & Skills

  • 5+ years’ experience in PLM products, including at least 3 years in PTC Windchill and 2 years in Dassault Systèmes 3DExperience .
  • 6+ years of system analysis and design experience , including enterprise-level application solutions (multi-tier, client/server, database, or web-based).
  • Experience with full software development lifecycle (SDLC) and formal project management methodologies.
  • Functional expertise in PLM applications ; technical domain knowledge is a plus.
  • Experience with Windchill 13 preferred.
  • Knowledge of BOM Views, MPMLink, Variant Configuration, Options and Variants highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with other PTC tools (Creo Parametric, Creo View, Integrity, ThingWorx) beneficial.
  • Experience extending the digital thread upstream/downstream from PLM an advantage.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications.
  • Willingness to learn, recommend, and apply new technologies.

A Aperam South América, líder em inovação e sustentabilidade, está em busca de uma pessoa Analista Tributária Especializada para integrar nossa equipe.

Desde 2011, a Aperam South América integra o Grupo Aperam, segundo maior da Europa, composto de outras cinco plantas industriais na França e na Bélgica, cuja capacidade alcança 2,5 milhões de toneladas de aço por ano.

No Brasil, a usina de Timóteo utiliza 100% de energia renovável graças à sua unidade no Vale do Jequitinhonha: a Aperam BioEnergia, que produz e comercializa carvão vegetal, tecnologia, mudas e sementes, a partir de florestas renováveis de eucalipto.

Com um modelo sustentável único em seu segmento, a Aperam South América é carbono neutro nos escopos 1 e 2 desde 2020, além de ser uma das poucas siderúrgicas brasileiras certificadas com o selo ResponsibleSteel.

Se você é apaixonada por sustentabilidade e quer fazer parte de uma transformação positiva no setor de aços inoxidáveis e elétricos, esta é sua oportunidade!

Por que escolher a Aperam?

Somos um lugar incrível para trabalhar! No segmento de Siderurgia e Mineração, conquistamos o 2º lugar no Prêmio “Lugares Incríveis para Trabalhar” , posição que mantemos há cinco anos. Esse reconhecimento reflete o nível de satisfação de nossas pessoas colaboradoras e nossa excelência em gestão de pessoas, clima organizacional e liderança.

Acreditamos que a diversidade fortalece nossa equipe e que a inclusão é essencial para um ambiente mais inovador e colaborativo. Buscamos pessoas que queiram crescer em um time que valoriza diferentes perspectivas e experiências.

Se você é uma pessoa apaixonada por sustentabilidade e quer fazer parte de uma transformação positiva no setor de aços inoxidáveis e elétricos, esta é sua oportunidade!

O que buscamos?

Assegurar a execução de processos tributários de altíssima complexidade.

Suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Atuar no compliance e planejamento tributário, com foco em tributos indiretos.
  • Garantir a conformidade das rotinas fiscais relacionadas a tributos indiretos, prestando suporte técnico à equipe e também contribuindo nas atividades de apuração, fechamento contábil, entrega de obrigações acessórias, contabilizações e conciliações, validações sistêmicas, além de apoiar no atendimento a fiscalizações e auditorias.

  • Assumir papel de referência técnica em tributos indiretos, liderando discussões e contribuindo para decisões na área financeira.
  • Conduzir projetos estratégicos da área, bem como de otimização de rotinas fiscais, incluindo atualizações tributárias ou sistêmicas de alto impacto para o departamento.
  • Manter-se atualizado em relação às alterações da legislação tributária, com atenção especial à Reforma Tributária, avaliando impactos e propondo adaptações necessárias.

O perfil que estamos buscando para essa posição:

  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis e/ou Direito.
  • Inglês avançado, com capacidade de leitura, escrita e conversação em ambiente corporativo.

  • Conhecimento em ERP e soluções fiscais, sendo o SAP um diferencial.
  • Especialização em Finanças ou Planejamento Tributário será considerada um diferencial.
  • Perfil analítico, com visão de negócio, capacidade de identificar oportunidades e mitigar riscos.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para atuar de forma consultiva junto a diferentes áreas da companhia.

title: Pessoa Estagiária de Engenharia
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023 . Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Health Sciences Specialist
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.

About the Role

At Innodata , we partner with the world’s leading technology companies to build the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We are seeking smart, detail-oriented, and curious Language Specialists with native-level fluency in Portuguese to help shape how AI understands and uses language.

This is a unique opportunity for writers, editors, and linguists to contribute to the forefront of AI innovation. You’ll be instrumental in teaching LLMs how to think, reason, and communicate with greater fluency and human-like nuance.

Job Title: Language Specialist – LLM Programs (Full time)

Language Requirement: Native-level fluency in Portuguese language

Key Responsibilities:

  • Creating training data sets for AI models that will help improve their accuracy, fluency, coherence and/or voice
  • Annotating data to help AI models align with human values
  • Analyzing and improving the grammar, syntax, and sentence structure of both expert-generated training data and AI model-generated text to ensure it adheres to linguistic rules and conventions
  • Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, researchers, and software engineers to refine and iterate data sets
  • Contributing to evolving specifications for AI-model training and data recipes
  • Navigating a dynamic environment and adapting to shifting guidelines and flexible priorities

Requirements

  • Native-level fluency in Portuguese and strong proficiency in English
  • Excellent writing, editing, and linguistic analysis skills
  • Deep understanding of grammar, syntax, and stylistic subtleties
  • Research skills and an ability to fact-check effectively
  • Ability to work independently and meet daily deadlines

Assessment:

Candidates must pass our project-specific assessments (2) designed to evaluate their language proficiency and analytical abilities

  • Assessment 1: English
  • Assessment 2: LLM Evaluation

JD Industrials, a subsidiary of JD Group, focuses on industrial supply chain technologies and services, with a market capitalization of approximately $5 billion.

description:
We Are PepsiCo

Join PepsiCo and Dare for Better! We are the perfect place for curious people, thinkers and change agents. From leadership to front lines, we're excited about the future and working together to make the world a better place.

Being part of PepsiCo means being part of one of the largest food and beverage companies in the world, with our iconic brands consumed more than a billion times a day in more than 200 countries.

A career at PepsiCo means working in a culture where all people are welcome. Here, you can dare to be you. No matter who you are, where you're from, or who you love, you can always influence the people around you and make a positive impact in the world.

Know more: PepsiCoJobs

Join PepsiCo, dare for better.

The Opportunity

Serve as a technical reference in the tax area, focusing on compliance, tax planning, and strategic support to leadership. Ensure adherence to current legislation while identifying opportunities for tax efficiency.

Your Impact

This position is responsible for strategic tax planning analyses across all Brazilian legal entities within the group (PdB, PBI, PABB, Pepsicola), with a focus on anticipating tax impacts, identifying efficiency opportunities, and ensuring full compliance with applicable legislation.

1. Respond to tax-related inquiries from business areas, providing clear and accurate guidance aligned with current legislation.

2. Define and communicate tax rules applicable to all new company operations, ensuring proper implementation and compliance.

3. Periodically review and update existing tax rules used across the organization to reflect legislative changes and business needs.

4. Support the tax manager in delivering training sessions to business teams, aiming to raise awareness and mitigate tax-related risks.

5. Collaborate with the tax legal team on strategic analyses and technical assessments to identify opportunities for tax efficiency and risk reduction.

6. Provide tax support for innovation projects under evaluation by the Marketing team, including taxation analysis for new products.

7. Assist in the review of commercial and operational contracts from a tax perspective.

8. Maintain updated reports and dashboards for the tax manager, ensuring visibility of key metrics and ongoing initiatives.

9. Act as a key partner to the business in the implementation of the Brazilian tax reform, supporting impact assessments, process adjustments, and the transition to the new tax framework

Who Are We Looking For?

  • Solid understanding of tax legislation; Understanding of tax accounting, including bookkeeping, calculation of taxes and contributions and development of tax returns.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law (with OAB) or Accounting (with CRC). A degree in Business Administration with an MBA in Tax Management is also acceptable.
  • Experience in the tax area, with a background in compliance, planning, and strategic projects.
  • Solid knowledge of federal and state taxes, ancillary obligations, tax law, direct taxes, and corporate tax.
  • Intermediate to advanced English.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel; experience with SAP and Mastersaf is a plus.
  • Good negotiation and communication skills (oral and written). Proactiveness. Resilience. Strategic thinking.

If this is an opportunity that interests you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements.

What can you expect from us:

• Opportunities to learn and develop every day through a wide range of programs.

• Internal digital platforms that promote self-learning.

• Development programs according to Leadership skills.

• Specialized training according to the role.

• Learning experiences with internal and external providers.

• We love to celebrate success, which is why we have recognition programs for seniority, behavior, leadership, moments of life, among others.

• Financial wellness programs that will help you reach your goals in all stages of life.

• A flexibility program that will allow you to balance your personal and work life, adapting your working day to your lifestyle.

• And because your family is also important to us, they can also enjoy benefits such as our Wellness Line, thousands of Agreements and Discounts, Scholarship programs for your children, Aid Plans for different moments of life, among others.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We respect and value diversity as a work force and innovation for the organization.

description:

Essa posição liderará a transformação para uma organização enxuta, conduzindo a implementação de ferramentas como Value Stream Management, PQPR, Segurança, 5S, TPM, Trabalho Padronizado, Sistemas Kanban/Pull, Análise de Causa Raiz, Qualidade na Fonte, Lean Daily Management, SMED, Poka-Yoke, Just-in-time, manufatura celular, A3/PDCA Problem Solving e ferramentas similares, com o objetivo de criar, sustentar e consolidar uma nova cultura de melhoria contínua e eficiência operacional.

Essa posição trabalhará em estreita colaboração com outras áreas da instalação, incluindo Qualidade de Serviço, Almoxarifado, Reparos & Manutenção, Suprimentos, HSE, Finanças, Operações, Recursos Humanos e Qualidade.

Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar a implantação e sustentação das iniciativas Lean em colaboração com os Gerentes de R&M e a Liderança da Instalação, garantindo alinhamento com as prioridades do negócio.
  • Conduzir atividades de mapeamento de fluxo de valor (VSM), desenvolver roadmaps de melhoria contínua e implementar planos de ação relacionados.
  • Identificar, padronizar e sustentar processos eficientes em toda a organização.
  • Implementar e orientar o uso de ferramentas Lean e de gestão diária, incluindo VSM, 5S, 5 Porquês, TPM, Trabalho Padronizado, Poka-Yoke, SIPOC, Mapeamento de Processos, Kanban, SMED, Gestão Visual, Hoshin Planning e ciclos de resolução de problemas PDCA/DMAIC.
  • Engajar colaboradores em todos os níveis, desde o chão de fábrica até a alta gestão, fomentando uma cultura de melhoria contínua por meio de gestão diária, Gemba Walks, 5S e práticas Lean.
  • Colaborar com equipes de R&M, líderes funcionais e colaboradores para identificar oportunidades de melhoria de processos e redução de desperdícios, categorizando iniciativas como ações, projetos ou eventos Kaizen.
  • Atuar como embaixador da mudança, promovendo a cultura Lean, impulsionando a excelência operacional e garantindo melhorias mensuráveis em eficiência e produtividade.
  • Oferecer suporte prático no chão de fábrica, liderando pelo exemplo e mantendo o engajamento dos colaboradores nas iniciativas Lean.

JD.com (NASDAQ: JD; HKEX: 9618), also known as JINGDONG (ranks 44 on 2025 Fortune Global 500), has evolved from a pioneering e-commerce platform into a leading technology and service provider with supply chain at its core. Key programs to be supported by this position include:

  • Analyze processes and related data to support the definition and deployment Samsung’s logistics strategy for Latin America, covering Finished Goods and Spare Parts operations across key markets (Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami).
  • Run sales demand and logistics capacity analysis to support “Long Term Capacity Planning” program, that involves logistics network design, warehouse infrastructure (including automation projects), and transportation modes.
  • Lead and/or support analyses to identify new opportunities for operational efficiency improvements and cost savings, such as:
  • Productivity increases for warehouse handling and transportation.
  • Warehouse storage efficiency enhancements.
  • Lead time reductions.
  • Apply problem-solving skills and an innovative mindset to create, redesign, and implement processes and tools that optimize logistics operations and improve governance in Latin America.
  • Focus on areas such as planning, control, and analysis to support logistics optimization.
  • Work closely with internal teams, suppliers, and external partners to gather information and carry on the necessary analysis of logistics operations process and performance across Latin America.
  • Foster strong collaboration with Procurement, IT, and other departments to drive efficiency and innovation.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders to address concerns, implement solutions, and ensure alignment with organizational goals.
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate logistics performance and identify areas for improvement.
  • Prepare detailed reports on logistics operations, cost-saving initiatives, and process innovations for senior management.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and best practices to enhance logistics processes.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or a related field.
  • Proven experience in logistics, supply chain management, or related fields.
  • Experience in logistics operations and/or projects across Latin American countries (e.g., Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami; not necessarily in all of them).
  • Experience in network design projects and logistics capacity planning.
  • Familiarity with logistics management software (WMS, TMS), ERP systems, and automation technologies.
  • Ability to prepare detailed analysis, graphics and reports to support and/or make presentations senior management.
  • Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams, internal and external partners.
  • Advanced Excel proficiency. Power BI is a Plus.
  • Fluent in English (mandatory).
  • Spanish proficiency (desirable).

Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

title: Especialista Clinico
description:
3M Health Care agora é Solventum

Na Solventum, possibilitamos cuidados de saúde melhores, mais inteligentes e mais seguros para melhorar vidas. Como uma nova empresa com um longo legado na criação de soluções inovadoras para os desafios mais difíceis dos nossos clientes, somos pioneiros em inovações revolucionárias na interseção da saúde, dos materiais e da ciência de dados que mudam a vida dos pacientes para melhor, ao mesmo tempo que permitem aos profissionais de saúde atuar em o melhor deles. Porque as pessoas e o seu bem-estar estão no centro de cada avanço científico que buscamos.

Estabelecemos parcerias estreitas com as mentes mais brilhantes da área da saúde para garantir que cada solução que criamos combina a tecnologia mais recente com compaixão e empatia. Porque na Solventum nunca paramos de resolver para você.

O impacto que você causará nesta função:

Nesta função você impactará na melhoria das práticas clínicas em Key Accounts atendidos pela Solventum, por meio de ações educacionais e treinamentos para promover a adesão a recomendações, standards e protocolos baseados em evidências e desta forma acelerar a adoção de tecnologias Solventum, alinhado com a estratégia da Divisão Medical Surgical.

Como Especialista Clínico(a) na Solventum, você terá a oportunidade de colaborar com profissionais inovadores e diversos, contribuindo diretamente para a transformação de práticas clínicas em instituições hospitalares.

Aqui, você causará impacto ao:

  • Promover melhorias clínicas por meio da apresentação de evidências científicas, programas educacionais e treinamentos técnicos em instituições hospitalares;
  • Realizar apoio técnico e educacional para acelerar o fechamento do ciclo de novas oportunidades de introdução e/ou geração de demanda das tecnologias Solventum para o segmento de Prevenção de Infecção em Sítio Cirúrgico (foco em Preparo da Pele e Normotermia) e Esterilização de Dispositivos Médicos (CME);
  • Utilizar ferramentas de economia da saúde para embasar estratégias de introdução de novas tecnologias nas instituições, agregando valor às decisões clínicas e administrativas;
  • Capacitar equipes internas e da rede de distribuição , garantindo excelência técnica e alinhamento estratégico;
  • Contribuir com insights relevantes para o desenvolvimento de estratégias de negócio e apoiar o lançamento de novos produtos no mercado.

Suas habilidades e conhecimentos

Para prepará-lo para o sucesso nesta função desde o primeiro dia, a Solventum exige (no mínimo) as seguintes qualificações:

  • Bacharelado (concluído e verificado antes do início) em Enfermagem. Especialização em CC e CME.
  • Três (3) anos de experiência clínica em instituições hospitalares na área de Centro Cirúrgico (CC) ou Centro de Material e Esterilização (CME) e/ou Controle de Infecção (CCIH) em Bloco Operatório.
  • Conhecimento teórico e prático na construção de protocolos e implementação de boas práticas para Prevenção de ISC (Centro Cirúrgico e CME).
  • Experiência prática como treinador/professor/instrutor.
  • Ótimos conhecimentos no pacote Office (Power Point, Excel, Outlook).
  • Inglês: intermediário para leitura
  • Carteira de habilitação atual e válida.

Qualificações adicionais que podem ajudá-lo a ter ainda mais sucesso nessa função incluem:

  • Pós-graduação em Centro Cirúrgico ou Central de Material e Esterilização ou áreas com afinidade.
  • Experiência com projetos de melhoria de processos, indicadores de qualidade, gerenciamento de riscos e/ou acreditações.
  • Experiência como consultor clínico em indústrias do segmento médico-hospitalar.
  • Conhecimento de guidelines e normativas para embasamento técnico e científico na elaboração de protocolos assistenciais visando boas práticas em Prevenção de ISC e Esterilização de Dispositivos Médicos
  • As habilidades incluem excelente comunicação escrita e oratória em público e prática na aplicação de dinâmicas de treinamentos.

Local de trabalho:

Remoto, em campo. Residir em Porto Alegre.

Disponibilidade total para viagens: atuação em campo visitando hospitais em RS, PR e SC.

Deve estar legalmente autorizado a trabalhar no país de trabalho sem patrocínio para status de visto de trabalho (por exemplo, status H1B).

Apoiando o seu bem-estar

Solventum oferece muitos programas para ajudá-lo a viver da melhor maneira possível – tanto física quanto financeiramente. Para garantir salários e benefícios competitivos, a Solventum compara regularmente com outras empresas comparáveis em dimensão e âmbito.

Por isso, reconhecemos a dedicação das nossas pessoas e estamos sempre em busca de quem deseja fazer a diferença e construir uma trajetória próspera e segura.

Na CPFL, você encontra um ambiente sólido para crescer com confiança, com segurança para evoluir e espaço para construir um futuro com propósito.

Analista de Qualidade e Documentação Jr

Onde você vai atuar: Campinas, SP

O seu dia a dia:

  • Gerir o sistema GED e monitorar a Gestão de Documentos da empresa;
  • Apoiar no ciclo de auditorias internas e externas, acompanhando auditores em atividades administrativas e de campo (sem adentrar ao SEP);
  • Participar de visitas de avaliação em ambientes administrativos e externos;
  • Prestar consultoria interna às áreas reguladas em temas de qualidade da gestão;
  • Elaborar relatórios e conteúdos de Qualidade para reuniões e fóruns;
  • Conduzir revisões de conceito e avaliações do Programa ColaborAtivo (5S);
  • Atuar em iniciativas e projetos internos de melhores práticas, trazendo atualização e valor agregado;
  • Apoiar atividades administrativas e orçamentárias;
  • Atuar na implantação e manutenção das certificações do Sistema de Gestão Integrado;
  • Contribuir com modelos de gestão e programas de qualidade voltados à excelência e à satisfação das partes interessadas.

O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Transporte;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Licença maternidade 6 meses e paternidade 20 dias
  • Auxílio creche (conforme regras de elegibilidade);

  • Wellhub;

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

title: Tech Lead | Design System e HTML5
description:
Como Tech Lead com foco em Design System e HTML5 na Sankhya, você terá um papel estratégico na arquitetura e evolução do framework de front-end da nossa aplicação.

Se você tem expertise avançada em React, HTML5, CSS3 e Design System, além de visão estratégica e habilidade para conduzir equipes, essa oportunidade é para você!

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

title: Project Accountant
description:
Role Purpose

The Project Accountant is a finance professional responsible for managing the financial control of strategic projects, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely reporting. This role requires not only technical expertise in project accounting but also strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with project teams, auditors, and international colleagues in a multicultural environment.

⸻

Core Responsibilities

• Financial Control & Compliance

• Maintain financial control over project accounts and ensure compliance with company policies and contractual terms.

• Support compliance with audit requirements and contractual obligations.

• Identify project-related risks and recommend mitigation strategies.

• Reporting & Deliverables

• Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reports, including cash flow statements and 17-week rolling forecasts .

• Calculate and monitor Percentage of Completion (POC) for revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15.

• Deliver accurate financial insights for decision-making, including variance analysis and project profitability.

• Prepare and monitor hedge calculations , manage multi-currency exposures, and advise on hedging needs.

• Ensure high-quality reporting standards with clear ownership of accuracy and completeness.

• Collaboration & Insights

• Work closely with project management, cost control, procurement, subcontracting, and planning teams to align financial data with operational activities.

• Translate operational progress into accurate financial impacts, including engineering team mobilization, project management teams, and marine vessel schedules .

• Interface with planners to ensure the timely and correct reflection of project milestones and costs.

• Serve as a key interface with internal stakeholders, auditors, and client representatives.

• Business Development & Bids

• Support the analysis of new bids and tenders , with particular focus on cash flow projections and financial feasibility.

• Provide insights to management on the potential financial risks and returns of new projects.

⸻

Key Qualifications

• Experience: Minimum of 5 years preferably in oil & gas, EPCI, or construction industries.

• Education: Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or Engineering.

• Technical Skills:

• Advanced Excel and strong ERP system knowledge.

• Solid understanding of POC revenue recognition, hedge accounting, and multi-currency project environments.

• Languages: Advanced to fluent in English & Portuguese.

• Soft Skills:

• Strong communication skills to effectively liaise with multicultural, international teams.

Buscamos alguém que una profunda expertise técnica, visão estratégica de software e habilidades de liderança para nos ajudar a construir soluções robustas e sustentáveis.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Manter a documentação técnica e o material de onboarding sempre atualizados.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas
  • Pós-graduação em Arquitetura de Software ou de Soluções
  • Pós-graduação em Gestão de Pessoas é desejável
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend, arquitetura de software e liderança técnica.
  • Histórico de participação em projetos escaláveis e performáticos.
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Portfólio técnico relevante (GitHub, projetos ou contribuições open source).

Competências Técnicas

  • Domínio Profundo do Ecossistema Java:
  • Java moderno: Spring Boot e ecossistema (security, data, etc.), Quarkus (desempenho), etc. para injeção de dependências, programação reativa, microsserviços, etc.
  • Java legado: Java EE (JSP, Servlets, EJB), Struts, JSF, etc. para manutenção, convivência, modernização, ,migração e/ou refatoração.
  • JVM e performance: domínio da JVM (garbage collection e tuning).
  • Arquitetura de Software e Design Patterns:
  • Desenho de soluções desacopladas, coesas e de fácil manutenção.
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões arquiteturais importantes e justificar suas decisões com base em requisitos técnicos e/ou de negócio.
  • Especialista em padrões de projetos clássicos (GoF: Gang of Four) e para microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos.
  • Expertise em Back-end e Visão Abrangente de Front-end:
  • Back-end: Java, DB (SQL: Oracle/SQL Sever, e NoSQL), mensageria (Kafka ou RabbitMQ), construção de APIs RESTful robustas e bem documentadas.
  • Front-end: é necessário conhecimento sólido dos fundamentos de front-end: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React e Angular.
  • Cultura de DevOps e Automação:
  • Experiência em CI/CD com GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.
  • Conhecimento de conteinerização com: Kubernetes, Docker, Nexus, etc.
  • Experiência e espírito de testes automatizados: unitários, integração e performance.
  • Qualidade, Segurança e Manutenção:
  • Code review, análise estática e dinâmica de código (SONAR), avaliação de métricas de qualidade do codebase.
  • Mentalidade de “segurança desde a concepção” e no caso de manutenção “a intervenção mínima e segura que resolve o problema”, sem sub ou over engineering.

Se você busca um desafio para liderar a evolução tecnológica de um dos maiores ERPs do país, com impacto direto na experiência de milhares de usuários, queremos te conhecer!

title: Advanced Process Control Engineer
description:
Dexcent Inc. has an opportunity for a Advanced Process Control Engineer to join our growing team in Fort McMurray, AB. The individual will be required to be on site and to relocate to Canada.

This opportunity is open to candidates both locally and internationally. We are prepared to support relocation for successful candidates, including assistance with visa sponsorship where applicable.

About Dexcent

Founded in 2006, Dexcent Inc. (Dexcent) is an engineering consulting firm that provides a range of specialized solutions for clients in a variety of industries throughout the world. Our professionals have modernized IT and OT engineering methodologies into comprehensive solutions, specializing in information analytics, cyber-security, infrastructure, and control systems engineering. As such, we pride ourselves on truly transforming industrial operations to optimize business performance and deliver bottom-line results.

About the Candidate

Our ideal candidate has the following skills and experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, or a related field preferred.
  • Advanced Process Control (APC) Certification from recognized institutions or organizations offering specialized training in APC technologies and methodologies preferred.
  • 3+ years experience with OSIsoft PI Historian for real-time data acquisition, storage, analysis, and visualization in an industrial or process control environment is required.
  • 5+ years experience with Honeywell Experion PKS, ESVT/EST, Honeywell TPS / TDC3000.
  • Process controllers: C300, C200, HPM, APM.
  • All variety of third-party PLC/devices integration to DCS.
  • Industrial Communication: Modbus RTU & Modbus TCP/IP, Serial Communication RS 485, RS 422, RS 232.
  • Networking Skills: Fault Tolerant Ethernet (FTE), Ethernet.
  • Configure and Administer Windows domain (Experion and TPS Domains).
  • OPC connectivity between Process control servers and other 3rd party servers.
  • MS Excel-macro based tools.
  • Experience configuring, implementing and trouble-shooting process control schemes in Honeywell TDC3000 (basic control algorithms and CL/AM code/PMX(basic control algorithms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Routine monitoring of APCs – this includes troubleshooting of APC related issues, direct communication with Process Engineers and Panel operators to address any issues affecting their ability to keep the APCs online, ensuring the optimization of the APCs are being met and evaluating the performance of soft sensors (inferentials) to ensure they do not drift from laboratory readings.
  • Reporting to relevant stakeholders about the APC performance – this includes a weekly APC report, Monthly Inferential and APC Stewardship reports and Monthly, Quarterly and Year to Date KPIs.
  • Development of new APC solutions and maintenance of existing applications. With the APC team being Regional this maybe at any of our client sites.
  • APC training of Operators and other interested parties.
  • Data Analysis – this is done in Excel or a number of different applications such as SEEQ or Honeywell Suite of products.
  • Support software and hardware upgrade activities that involve APC related equipment.
  • Other related duties as required.

At Dexcent we recognize that people are our most important asset. We appreciate the diverse experience, knowledge, creativity, and personality that each person brings to our organization, our culture, and our success.

If this sounds like the right career opportunity for you, apply today!

title: Especialista em Processos e Dados (Commercial Flows)
description:
Louis Dreyfus Company (LDC), established in 1851, is a leading global merchant and processor of agricultural goods (also called commodity trading) with more than 22 000 employees worldwide. LDC reported in 2014, the Group started to rotate to Process harmonization, Global Organizations and especially Digitalization by opening a Center of Excellence (CoE) for Finance, IT and HR based in Lyon.

Together with the CoE, the LDC Groups created a Global Finance Team, called FPSO (for Finance Processes Systems and Organization), which is reporting directly to the Group CFO and for which the aim is to:

  • Lead the Finance Transformation of the group
  • Digitalize LDC Processes and organizations
  • Help LDC to rotate to Finance best practices and best tools

In 2018, the Group materialized its ambition by initiated a Global Finance Transformation and Digitilization of its Back Office operations (Accounting, Controlling, Reporting, Procurement). It consists into a:

  • Reshaping of accounting and controlling processes
  • The implementation of SAP S/4 HANA suite including Business Intelligence, ARIBA

As of 2025, implementations have been done in several regions, including countries such as Argentina, Suisse, US, China. The program roadmap ends around 2028 and will be followed by other transformations project on other systems.

The FPSO team consist into an international team of experiences resources with strong expertise in there domain. They act as the keeper of the Group practices and solutions. They coordinate the different on-going project in the LDC world for their respective scope.

Main Responsibilities

The FPSO team is looking for FPSO Specialist Commercial Flows, who will be in charge of the one or more of the below E2E processes flows:

  • Purchase and Sales of commercial goods
  • Inventory management
  • Transportation flows

The FPSO Specialist Commercial flows:

  • On one side, guarantees the LDC Group practices and processes related to commercial processes
  • On the other side, support countries in their execution but also guarantee efficiency in terms of tools, organisation and processes.

This applies in different kind of activities:

  • Live countries support and small enhancements : enhance user experience, provide continuous improvement, be the core model keeper and supervise the delivery of changes, keep documentation up to date
  • Small projects, called “Ad-Hoc”: launch and drive initiatives to improve BOLD
  • BOLD implementations in new countries : act as a referent for CORE processes and data related to his scope. Find the balance between local needs and Group requirements
  • Innovation: support initiatives integrated with BOLD linked to innovation (analytics, automation, switch to paperless)

The FPSO Specialist Commercial flows will work for BOLD implementation in new countries, concretely in Brazil rollout (BORA Project), in charge of group of processes related to Commercial flows, as well as being responsible for scope and deadlines.

This role requires close relationship with our Business partners, other members of the Program, especially with, EPSO (for execution), IPSO (for Industry) and hand-in- hand collaboration with our DT&A departments and Front Office implementation team.

On top of his/her activities related to Global Finance Transformation, the FPSO Specialist Senior Commercial flow will help the group to switch to other transformation initiative (such as Artificial Intelligence, Business Intelligence, Block chain) by providing his/her functional expertise.

Qualifications

Experience

3/5 years of strong operational experience ideally.

The candidate will have several or more of the below items:

  • Experience from a Finance Consulting or Technology Consulting firm
  • Participation in Finance transformation project either as an internal or as an external resource
  • Experience in working in project mode and ability to perform in various roles from individual contributor to a leadership role
  • Experience in Finance Transformation projects, , specially focusing in Commercial flows areas
  • Working experience in companies dedicated to agriculture or commodity business
  • Experience in working in project mode
  • Experience in international environments
  • Experience in process design and implementation in an IT tool
  • Experience establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with other business organizations; successful experience in working with diverse groups of people in a problem-solving environment
  • Experience and expertise on SAP S/4 for SD and or FI modules

Other skills (Computer Skills, etc)

  • Fundamental understanding of core accounting and finance processes is required.
  • Strong ability to gather & analyze information, define problems and form a plan of action.
  • Evident ability to analyze and challenge workflows, being analytical and synthetic.
  • Exceptional organizational ability with a very strong attention to detail.
  • Must be able to work independently and take ownership of this role.
  • Experience establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with other business organizations; successful experience in working with diverse groups of people in a problem-solving environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work under time pressure and result oriented.

Languages:

Leading business school, Leading Engineer School, University degree in Business Administration with a major in:

  • Information System and/or
  • Finance/Accounting and/or

description:
Job Summary:

The Junior Accounting Analyst will play a key role in the accounting department, assisting with daily accounting activities and ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial data. This position is ideal for a proactive and detail-oriented individual looking to grow their career in finance. The analyst will be responsible for supporting various accounting functions, including journal entries, reconciliations, and assisting with month-end closing processes. This role provides an excellent opportunity to learn and develop a strong foundation in accounting principles. The Junior Accounting Analyst will report to the Accounting Manager.

Key Job Responsibilities:

1. Journal Entries:

  • Assist in making journal entries in financial and accounting systems, ensuring transactions are correctly classified and recorded.
  • Record routine operations such as payments, receipts, billing, and payroll, among others.

2. Account Reconciliation:

  • Perform bank reconciliations, and reconcile accounts receivable, accounts payable, inventory, and other balance sheet accounts.
  • Identify and investigate potential discrepancies, and accurately and timely reconcile balances.

3. Account Analysis and Variance Analysis:

  • Analyze accounting accounts, identifying variations, trends, and anomalies in balances.
  • Prepare account analysis reports and explain variances to the accounting team.

4. Financial Reporting:

  • Assist in preparing periodic financial reports, such as balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.
  • Collect and organize financial data to support management's decision-making.

5. Compliance with Tax and Regulatory Requirements:

  • Assist in preparing the necessary documentation and information to meet tax obligations, including tax returns and ancillary obligations.
  • Stay up-to-date with accounting and tax regulations, ensuring compliance with applicable standards and laws.

6. Support for Audits and Closing Processes:

  • Collaborate with internal and external auditors by providing requested documentation and information accurately and on time.
  • Support the monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting close processes, ensuring the integrity and accuracy of accounting records.

Qualifications:

  • Technical or bachelor’s degree in accounting.
  • Basic knowledge of financial accounting and accounting principles.
  • Familiarity with accounting systems and the Office suite, especially Excel.
  • Analytical skills and problem-solving abilities.
  • Good verbal and written communication

title: Especialista em Processos e Dados (Finance)
description:
Louis Dreyfus Company (LDC), established in 1851, is a leading global merchant and processor of agricultural goods (also called commodity trading) with more than 22 000 employees worldwide. LDC reported in 2014, the Group started to rotate to Process harmonization, Global Organizations and especially Digitalization by opening a Center of Excellence (CoE) for Finance, IT and HR based in Lyon.

Together with the CoE, the LDC Groups created a Global Finance Team, called FPSO (for Finance Processes Systems and Organization), which is reporting directly to the Group CFO and for which the aim is to:

  • Lead the Finance Transformation of the group
  • Digitalize LDC Processes and organizations
  • Help LDC to rotate to Finance best practices and best tools

In 2018, the Group materialized its ambition by initiated a Global Finance Transformation and Digitilization of its Back Office operations (Accounting, Controlling, Reporting, Procurement). It consists into a:

  • Reshaping of accounting and controlling processes
  • The implementation of SAP S/4 HANA suite including Business Intelligence, ARIBA

As of 2025, implementations have been done in several regions, including countries such as Argentina, Suisse, US, China. The program roadmap ends around 2028 and will be followed by other transformations project on other systems.

The FPSO team consist into an international team of experiences resources with strong expertise in there domain. They act as the keeper of the Group practices and solutions. They coordinate the different on-going project in the LDC world for their respective scope.

Main Responsibilities

The FPSO team is looking for Financial Specialist, who will be in charge of the one or more of the below E2E processes flows:

  • Payment flow (incl. integration with other systems), cash income flows and bank statement
  • Controlling
  • Accounting, fixed assets and months end closing
  • Integration with Consolidation and Reporting

The Financial Specialist:

  • On one side, guarantees the LDC Group practices and processes related to commercial processes
  • On the other side, support countries in their execution but also guarantee efficiency in terms of tools, organisation and processes

This applies in different kind of activities:

  • Live countries support and small enhancements : enhance user experience, provide continuous improvement, be the core model keeper and supervise the delivery of changes, keep documentation up to date
  • Small projects, called “Ad-Hoc”: launch and drive initiatives to improve BOLD
  • BOLD implementations in new countries : act as a referent for CORE processes and data related to his scope. Find the balance between local needs and Group requirements
  • Innovation: support initiatives integrated with BOLD linked to innovation (analytics, automation, switch to paperless)

The Financial Specialist will work for BOLD implementation in new countries, concretely in Brazil rollout (BORA Project), in charge of group of processes related to Finance flows, as well as being responsible for scope and deadlines.

This role requires close relationship with our Business partners, other members of the Program such as PPSO (for procurement), EPSO (for execution), IPSO (for Industry) and hand-in- hand collaboration with our DT&A departments.

On top of his/her activities related to Global Finance Transformation, the Financial Specialist will help the group to switch to other transformation initiative (such as Artificial Intelligence, Business Intelligence, Block chain) by providing his/her functional expertise.

Qualifications

Experience

3/5 years of strong operational experience ideally.

The candidate will have several or more of the below items:

  • Experience from a Finance Consulting or Technology Consulting firm
  • Participation in Finance transformation project either as an internal or as an external resource
  • Experience in working in project mode and ability to perform in various roles from individual contributor to a leadership role
  • Experience in Finance Transformation projects,
  • Working experience in companies dedicated to agriculture or commodity business
  • Experience in working in project mode
  • Experience in international environments
  • Experience in process design and implementation in an IT tool
  • Experience establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with other business organizations; successful experience in working with diverse groups of people in a problem-solving environment
  • Experience and expertise on SAP S/4 for one or more FI submodules or processes

Other skills (Computer Skills, etc)

  • Fundamental understanding of core accounting and finance processes is required.
  • Strong ability to gather & analyze information, define problems and form a plan of action.
  • Evident ability to analyze and challenge workflows, being analytical and synthetic.
  • Exceptional organizational ability with a very strong attention to detail.
  • Must be able to work independently and take ownership of this role.
  • Experience establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with other business organizations; successful experience in working with diverse groups of people in a problem-solving environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work under time pressure and result oriented.

Languages:

  • English (fluent)

Academics

Leading business school, Leading Engineer School, University degree in Business Administration with a major in:

  • Information System and/or
  • Finance/Accounting and/or
  • Process & organization management

description:
Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.

Position Overview:

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.

Primary Responsibilities:

1. Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of

our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance,

reliability, and scalability.

2. Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and

support business processes

3. API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal

and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare

systems and third-party services.

4. Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare

industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining

robust security measures and data protection protocols.

Additional Responsibilities:

1. Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in

backend development, code review, and team collaboration.

2. Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to

continually innovate and enhance the platform.

3. Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint

planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of

high-quality software.

4. Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface

and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end

functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.

Competencies/Requirements:

1. Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL.

Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.

2. Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a

proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web

applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is

highly desirable.

3. Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think

analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

4. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills,

capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and

stakeholders.

5. Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design

specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and

efficient platform.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth

Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.

title: Medical Writer Subject Matter Expert
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel, and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.

About the Role:

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.

We are seeking a Medical Writer Subject Matter Expert with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality medical and scientific content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and communicate clinical and biomedical information.

Key Responsibilities:

Create high-quality, accurate, and medically sound content, including:

  • Clinical and scientific explanations of medical topics
  • Research summaries, clinical abstracts, and literature reviews
  • Patient education materials
  • Medical problem sets, case studies, and evidence-based Q&A
  • Regulatory, pharmacological, or public health-focused content (as applicable)

Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:

  • Review and refine medical-related model outputs
  • Identify and address conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build diverse datasets across medical and healthcare domains (e.g., anatomy, pathology, pharmacology, public health, epidemiology, evidence-based medicine)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, comprehension, and communication of healthcare content

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Medicine, Biomedical Sciences, Pharmacy, Public Health, or a related healthcare/clinical discipline
  • (Exceptional candidates with professional degrees such as MD, DO, PharmD, MPH, or equivalent clinical experience will be considered)
  • Strong background in medical/scientific writing, with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly and accurately
  • Experience with literature review, evidence synthesis, or regulatory writing is a plus
  • Familiarity with scientific publishing standards, citation practices, and biomedical databases (e.g., PubMed, Cochrane)

Additional Requirement:

As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

This assessment is mandatory and non-billable.

title: Human Resource Supervisor
description:
Job Summary

Responsible for human resources management of the company in the Brazilian region. Through formulating and implementing effective HR strategies, ensure sufficient human resources support for the company's business operations in Brazil, maintain good employee relations, guarantee the compliance and high - efficiency of the company's HR management, and enhance the overall HR effectiveness.

Job Responsibilities

(1) Employee Relations Management

  1. Regularly conduct employee satisfaction surveys. Understand employees' satisfaction with HR and company management through questionnaires and other means, and strive to improve employee satisfaction.
  2. Actively handle labor disputes. Collaborate with the legal department to ensure the victory in labor lawsuits and avoid significant losses caused by losing cases.
  3. Ensure the efficient completion of probation - to - regular and contract renewal processes, and safeguard the compliance and stability of employees' employment relations.
  4. Strengthen employee compliance management. Promptly identify and correct employees' non - compliant behaviors, and reduce the situations where employees violate the company's interests and Brazilian labor laws.
  5. Monitor the turnover of key employees and strengthen the stability control of the workforce.

(2) Performance Management

  1. Regularly provide performance optimization suggestions that are recognized by business departments and approved by management to adapt the performance system to the business characteristics in Brazil.
  2. Ensure the performance processes are carried out as planned and avoid delaying employee incentives due to process delays.

(3) Training Management

Optimize training content to be in line with Brazilian regulations, job requirements, or employees' feedback. Ensure the optimization can be implemented as confirmed by business departments, and improve the pertinence and practicality of training.

(4) Business Support

  1. Regularly conduct talent inventory to clarify the company's human resources structure and support the talent allocation for the business expansion of the Brazilian subsidiary.
  2. Ensure the timely completion of salary surveys, make the salary strategy suitable for the local market level in Brazil, and enhance the company's talent competitiveness.
  3. Ensure the on - schedule progress of talent mapping work. Use talent maps to accurately locate target talents (such as those with scarce industry skills) and support the recruitment and reserve for key positions.
  4. Provide operational optimization suggestions from the perspective of HR management, identify optimization points in the operational processes (such as HR processes and cross - departmental collaboration) of the Brazilian subsidiary, and improve efficiency and reduce costs.

(5) Compensation Management

Liaise with payroll agencies and comprehensively manage salary payment matters for the company in Brazil. Ensure the accuracy and timeliness of payroll data, including but not limited to the calculation and payment of employees' salaries, bonuses, and benefits. Maintain close communication with payroll agencies, promptly handle problems and abnormal situations during salary payment, and guarantee that employees' salaries are paid on time and in full.

(6) Team Management

Effectively manage and empower subordinate specialists (focusing on recruitment, payment, and training) to ensure that they meet the work requirements.

Qualifications

(1) Educational Background

A bachelor's degree or above in human resources management, business administration, or related majors.

(2) Work Experience

Over 5 years of human resources management work experience, with at least 2 years of HR management experience in Brazil or multinational companies. Those with experience in handling Brazilian labor legal affairs are preferred.

(3) Skills Requirements

  1. Familiar with local labor laws and regulations and the human resources market situation in Brazil.
  2. Possess excellent data analysis skills to evaluate the achievement of various HR indicators through data.
  3. Proficient in knowledge and skills of all HR management modules, including performance management, training management, and employee relations management.
  4. Have good communication and coordination skills and team management abilities, and be able to effectively communicate and collaborate with different departments and employees.

(4) Language Proficiency

Fluent in Portuguese and English for daily work communication and document processing.

(5) Other Requirements

Have a strong sense of responsibility, good stress - resistance and problem - solving abilities, and be able to work in a complex cross - cultural environment.

The professional will play a transformative role in defining and deploying Samsung's Logistics Strategy for Latin America (Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami) for Finished Goods (all product lines) and Spare Parts operations. Key programs to be carried out by this position include:

  • Long-Term Capacity Planning: Process Implementation and Improvement: Logistics Network Design, Warehouse Infrastructure (including automation projects), Transportation Modes, etc.
  • Cost Efficiency Program: Manage the project pipeline (PMO) and lead analyses to identify new opportunities for operational efficiency improvements and cost savings (productivity increases for warehouse handling and transportation, warehouse storage efficiency, lead time reductions, LSP management, etc.).
  • Process Innovation: Apply problem-solving skills and an innovative mindset to create, redesign, and implement processes and tools that support logistics operations optimization and better governance in Latin America (planning, control, analysis).

  • Productivity increases for warehouse handling and transportation.

  • Apply problem-solving skills and an innovative mindset to create, redesign, and implement processes and tools that optimize logistics operations and improve governance in Latin America.

  • Proven experience in logistics, supply chain management, or related fields.
  • Experience in logistics operations and/or projects across Latin American countries (e.g., Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami; not necessarily in all of them).
  • Experience in network design projects and logistics capacity planning.
  • Familiarity with logistics management software (WMS, TMS), ERP systems, and automation technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cost efficiency programs, including project pipeline management (PMO).
  • Expertise in identifying and implementing operational efficiency improvements and cost-saving initiatives.

title: Senior Software Engineer - LLM / AI-Enabled Systems
description:
About Health Note

Health Note is building AI-powered digital assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. Instead of rigid,disconnected software modules, ourassistants gain skills over time — from handling simple reschedules to managing complex intake, referrals, and medication refills. Patients experience a natural,empathetic interaction, while providers gain a system that is reliable, transparent, and continually improving. Our goal is to deliver a concierge experience forevery patient, and a scalable path to automation for every clinic.

About the Role

This role is an opportunity to join a high-impact team with tremendous growth opportunities. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible fordeveloping and maintaining mission-critical systems that power healthcare operations and interoperability for over 60 clinics and health systems.

At Health Note, we’re not building new AI models — we’re using services to deliver digital

assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. These assistants grow new skills over time, handle complex patient-facing workflows safely andreliably, and transform healthcare operations into a continuous improvement process. The result is not just reliable automation, but a human and empatheticexperience that patients and providers trust.

As part of a cross-functional team, you’ll collaborate with product managers, solution engineers, and client experience managers to create world-class, AI-enabled solutions. You’ll shape architectural decisions, integration patterns, and developer workflows so that AI isn’t just “bolted on,” but thoughtfullyincorporated into our platform.

This opportunity is ideal if you want to take the next step in your career and join a growth-stage organization focused on healthcare — while working at thefrontier of AI-enabled software development.

We’re a fully distributed, remote-first, fast-growing startup. Our engineering team is spread from UTC-3 to UTC-7 and we rely heavily on strong asynchronouscommunication. Occasionally, you’ll need to flex to sync up with teammates across time zones.

Our cutting-edge stack is full-stack Typescript leveraging NestJS, React, Remix, Tailwinds,GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Pulumi, all on AWS. Our architecture isservice oriented and managed in a Monorepo.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable and performant servicesand applications.
  • Integrate LLMs and AI services into production systems, with attention tosafety, observability, performance, and cost effectiveness.
  • Build abstractions, APIs, and internal tooling that make it easier for otherengineers and product teams to leverage AI responsibly.
  • Continually improve the codebase and test coverage through refactoring,automated testing, CI/CD, and strong developer productivity practices.
  • Experiment with emerging AI technologies and evaluate their fit for ourproducts, balancing speed-to-market with reliability.
  • Mentor and support other engineers, setting coding standards andarchitectural practices that ensure long-term maintainability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design AI-enabled productexperiences that meet real client needs.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building robust, scalable full-stack applications,databases, and developer tools.
  • Hands-on experience working with LLMs or AI services (e.g., OpenAI,Anthropic, Vertex AI, Llama) in a professional or personal capacity.
  • Significant experience designing, building, deploying, and maintainingproduction applications at scale.
  • Proficiency with Javascript/Typescript, React, NodeJS (NestJS), andPostgresQL.
  • Familiarity with modern web technologies ( WebSockets, gRPC,GraphQL).
  • Comfort architecting solutions to ambiguous problems with significantimpact.
  • Experience leaving the codebase better than you found it throughautomated testing, CI/CD, and observability.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks for AI-enabled features (e.g.,measuring quality, accuracy, and reliability of LLM outputs).
  • Familiarity with RAG, embedding algorithms, and intent classification.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring systems (Langfuse,Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, Cloudwatch, etc.).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code in production.
  • Familiarity with internal UI and integration tools (ReTool, SalesforceCommunities, Contentful, NextJS, etc.).
  • Experience with containers and orchestrators like Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Background in healthcare, regulated industries, or EHR/EMR integration.
  • Experience debugging distributed systems.

You do not need to have prior experience with every technology in our stack. We believe great candidates are capable of learning new tools quickly, and weprovide mentorship and guidance as needed.

We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

As operações do Grupo Blanver contam com duas plantas de produção no Brasil – uma na cidade de Taboão da Serra, onde são fabricados os medicamentos, e a outra em Indaiatuba, para a produção de IFAs. Além destas, temos um escritório central no bairro Morumbi em São Paulo e uma filial de expedição na cidade de Itajaí, SC. Sobre Phibro Animal Health Corporation

A Phibro Animal Health Corporation é uma organização global de capital aberto com uma rica história em saúde e nutrição animal que fabrica e comercializa aditivos medicamentosos para alimentação animal, vacinas, produtos de especialidades nutricionais e nutrição mineral. A Phibro é uma empresa diversificada. Além de nutrição e saúde animal, fabricamos e comercializamos produtos para melhorar a performance na produção de etanol, microbianos para plantas, aplicações domésticas e industriais e especialidades químicas para vários mercados industriais.

A posicão de Estagiário de Produção é um componente importante de nosso time de Manufatura localizado em Guarulhos.

  • Monitoramento de planos preventivos;
  • Acompanhamento de processos operacionais na manufatura.

Formação & Especializações:

  • Ensino Superior Cursando do 4º ao 6º semestre em: Engenharia Química, Engenharia Bioquímica ou Bacharel em Química.

Phibro é uma empresa que propicia oportunidades iguais a todos

Todos os candidatos qualificados para a posição serão considerados independentemente de raça, nacionalidade, sexo, idade, religião, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, condição de veterano, estado civil ou quaisquer outras características protegidas por lei.

description:

Produzir e disseminar relatórios executivos da carteira, pipeline de renovações e oportunidades, consolidando insights para a liderança e contribuindo para o planejamento comercial.

Formação superior completa, preferencialmente em Administração, Economia, Ciências Atuariais, Marketing, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas;

Pós Graduação será um diferencial;

Vivência nas áreas de Mercado de seguros de Vida e Seguro Viagem, produtos, cobertura, tributação e mecanismos de precificação e tarifação;

Ter atuado com gestão de relacionamento com clientes corporativos e canais de distribuição (corretores, assessorias, bancos, parceiros digitais, etc);

Habilidade com gestão por indicadores (NPS, sinistralidade, persistência, churn, prêmios, receita, margem);

Ter habilidade com ferramentas de CRM, BI e produtividade (Salesforce ou similar);

Excel e PowerPoint avançado.
